notes: No changes. Existing stories fully cover schema, logic, API/UI, tests, and integration without duplication.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.description: Define response schema exposing matched_classifications, source pipelines (regex, vector), and attribution flags for each classification.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S2.title: Implement Dual-Pipeline Attribution Logic
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S2.description: Extend specialty_service to tag each matched classification with originating pipeline(s) (regex, vector) and handle deduplication with combined attribution.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S3.title: Expose Specialty Transparency via Facade/API
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S3.description: Update find_care_facade and/or evaluate_care_facade to include specialty transparency fields in provider search responses without breaking existing contracts.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.title: Render Specialty Match Transparency in Chat UI
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.description: Display matched specialties with indicators of how they were identified (regex, vector, or both) in MessageBubble or ChatWindow without cluttering UX.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Transparency
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.description: Add tests validating pipeline attribution accuracy, schema contract compliance, and end-to-end propagation from specialty_service through API to UI.
